subject.title: fix(telegram): record sent messages in the source-delivery path

question: Should this PR wait for a live Telegram source-delivery plus reaction proof, or should maintainers explicitly override that proof requirement based on the focused stub-backed coverage?
rationale: The implementation appears correct, but repository policy requires real Telegram evidence for this reply-context behavior and the contributor cannot exercise a credentialed live Telegram setup.

options.title: Capture live Telegram proof
options.body: Run the source-delivery and reaction scenario against a real Telegram chat, attach redacted evidence, then merge after the rebased head is green.

options.title: Approve a proof override
options.body: Explicitly accept the real delivery-plus-ledger coverage with only the Bot API boundary stubbed and own the remaining live integration uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Capture live Telegram proof
recommendation.body: Run the source-delivery and reaction scenario against a real Telegram chat, attach redacted evidence, then merge after the rebased head is green.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work owns the current Telegram delivery funnel most directly affected by this proof decision.
